name: cashflow
description: Personal expense tracker with a daily spending allowance

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
